record_types.name: hardware_issue
record_types.description: Issued hardware manifest captured at onboarding time

fields.hardware_id: Stable hardware identifier for the issued node
fields.serial_number: Vendor serial number or asset tag
fields.mac_addresses: Array of MAC addresses associated with the platform
fields.issued_at: ISO 8601 timestamp for the issuance event
fields.source_file: Path to the source hardware file that was indexed
fields.checksum: SHA-256 digest of the source hardware file
fields.boot_profile: Optional boot or PXE profile name
fields.operator: Operator or automation identity that issued the record

record_types.name: hedera_sequence_log
record_types.description: Hedera sequence record associated with a hardware issue

fields.sequence_id: Sequence identifier used for lookup and linkage
fields.hardware_id: Hardware record linked to this sequence
fields.status: Sequence state such as pending, confirmed, or failed
fields.source_file: Log file or ledger export that produced the record
fields.payload_hash: Digest of the raw log payload
